Are you a strategic marketing leader who thrives on building brands, growing communities, and delivering measurable business results across multiple markets? This is a great opportunity for an experienced Marketing Manager to lead marketing activities across Switzerland, Italy, Portugal, and Spain (CHIPS region) for an iconic Global Brand This is a high-impact leadership role with responsibility for shaping and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, customer engagement, lead generation, and commercial growth. Working closely with regional Sales, Operations, Dealer Development, and Marketing teams, you will have the opportunity to influence market performance, lead a talented team, and create exceptional customer experiences across some of Europe's most exciting and diverse markets. About the Role Lead marketing strategy across four key European markets. Manage significant marketing investment and influence commercial outcomes. Work within a collaborative, international environment where your ideas can make a real impact. Lead a talented regional team and help shape the future of the brand experience. Drive innovative, digital-first campaigns that connect with passionate customer communities. Enjoy opportunities for professional growth, international collaboration, and leadership development. Responsibilities Strategic Marketing Leadership Lead end-to-end marketing planning across Switzerland, Italy, Portugal, and Spain. Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with regional and global business objectives. Translate strategic priorities into actionable market and dealer-level plans. Campaign & Channel Management Oversee execution and optimisation across: Paid media Social media PR and earned media CRM and email marketing Retail and partner marketing Experiential and live events Ensure campaigns deliver against clearly defined KPIs and business objectives. Performance & Growth Drive demand generation, lead acquisition, customer engagement, and community growth. Monitor performance, analyse results, and optimise investment to maximise ROI. Manage large-scale marketing budgets (approximately €3 million). Leadership & Collaboration Lead, coach, and develop the regional marketing team. Foster a positive, high-performing, and inclusive team culture. Partner closely with Sales, Operations, and Dealer Development teams to deliver integrated commercial plans. Manage external agencies and strategic marketing partners across multiple markets. Events & Customer Experience Lead planning and execution of regional events, exhibitions, customer activations, community programmes, and partner events. Create memorable experiences that strengthen customer loyalty and brand advocacy. Required Skills 8+ years' experience in marketing leadership roles. Experience in automotive, premium consumer products, lifestyle, retail, sports, or related industries. Proven success developing and executing marketing strategies across multiple countries or regions. Strong people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and team development. Deep understanding of digital-first, omnichannel marketing. Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive business decisions. Experience managing substantial marketing budgets and multiple agency relationships. Outstanding stakeholder management and communication skills. Fluency in English and Italian.
